discussion_comments.comment_body: **Fixed in cbf6f7f2d49.** The allowlist is now evaluated against the `mcp://` URI BEFORE `discoverExtension` is called, so a blocked link no longer triggers any backend manifest fetch or initialize probe to an unapproved/internal host. The resolved endpoint is still re-checked after discovery (defense in depth). In strict allowlist mode admins allow the `mcp://` URI/host; server-side enforcement could be a follow-up.
